---
title: "Getting started"
---

## Set up

Create a GitHub account and ask the supervisor for repository access, or use a fork. Install Git and [Quarto](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/). Clone the repository and run `quarto preview` to view it locally.

## Learn the workflow

Read [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/Donggyurim/neuroimaging-training/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). Make your first task a small documentation improvement so you can practise branching, committing, pushing, and requesting review.

## Plan your research

With the supervisor, choose an accessible dataset and a question suitable for your placement. Before analysis, record the dataset identifier and version, access terms, selection criteria, proposed method, expected output, and quality checks in a Student task issue.

Use the [previous student's guide](https://neuroimaging-guide.netlify.app/01-data) as a learning reference. Ask the supervisor to confirm which steps fit your dataset and question. This repository has not imported or independently validated that guide.

## Make a reproducible contribution

Copy the relevant template from `templates/`, document your environment and commands, and keep data outside the repository. Run and inspect your analysis separately; the website only renders documentation. Add your page to the navigation and open a draft PR early.
